title: Section-complex base change for the specified finite affine Cech model
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], $F$ quasi-coherent [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U\subset T$ affine and $(V_i)_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)}$ a finite family of affine opens in $Y=f^{-1}U$. No covering assumption is made. Let a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] be given by $g:T^\prime\to U$, $g^\prime:X^\prime\to X$, $f^\prime:X^\prime\to T^\prime$ and $f$. Put $M=(g^\prime)^*F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and $W_i=(g^\prime)^{-1}(j_Y(V_i))$, indexing the new family by the universe lift of $\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Let $D$ be any nonnegative complex of $\mathcal O_{X^\prime}$-modules, with presheaf term identifications $e_p$ with the usual Cech terms for $W,M$, respecting differentials and local scalar actions as in [lem-pc-linear-cech-sheaf-resolution]. An augmentation and exactness of $D$ are not assumed. For every $q\geq0$ there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{T^\prime}$-modules $H^q(g^*C(f|_U,F|_Y,V))\simeq H^q(f^\prime_*D)$, where $C$ is the specified complex [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. No flatness or injective resolutions are needed.

source.place: Tag 02KE, affine termwise calculation; Tags 01FJ, 01FK and 01FM, ordered Cech comparison

proof.text: Apply the termwise coordinate theorem to the specified pulled-back model and M = gprime pullback F. It supplies the increasing-tuple additive equivalences, restriction compatibility, local scalar action, and signed differential equation on every open of Tprime.

The specified finite affine model has zero negative terms, and additive pullback preserves this property. Apply the ordered module-sheaf comparison to the coordinates and the given e, hd and hlinear. It gives a homotopy equivalence from the pulled-back model to the direct image of D extended by zero.

For each natural q, apply HomotopyEquiv.toHomologyIso at integer q. Compose it with HomologicalComplex.extendHomologyIso for embeddingUpNat at q; this identifies the extended homology with the original natural-degree homology of pushforward D. The composition is the required module-sheaf isomorphism.

theorem finiteAffineCech_section_baseChange {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {r : ℕ}
    (V : Fin r → (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (W : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ i, W i = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ V i.down))
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F).presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F).presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ((Modules.pullback g').obj F, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                ((Modules.pullback g').obj F).presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s) :
    ∀ q : ℕ,
      Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          (finiteAffineCechModel (f ∣_ U) (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι) V)).homology q ≅
        (((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).homology q)
